results.title: What TV Channel Is Broadcasting the Super Bowl?
results.content:
Super Bowl LX will be broadcast on NBC on Feb. 8, 2026. 

NBC last broadcasted a Super Bowl in 2022 when the Rams beat the Bengals.

## Super Bowl Broadcasters

NBC’s team of Mike Tirico and Cris Collinsworth will be the broadcasters for Super Bowl LX.

## Super Bowl Broadcast Schedule

CBS, FOX and NBC have rotated which network gets the Super Bowl for years. Here are the future broadcast networks, which will include ABC/ESPN: [...] | Super Bowl | Date | Network |

results.title: Who's calling Super Bowl 60? Full NBC announcer lineup
results.content: NBC owns the broadcast rights to this year's Super Bowl, which means game analyst Cris Collinsworth will be on the call. The former NFL wide receiver has called five Super Bowls in his career as a broadcaster so far, and all but one of them have featured the New England Patriots competing for the Lombardi Trophy.
